question: Which state/local/educational grants disbursed by federal agencies in FY24 show the highest composite clawback-risk score, computed from recipient churn, outlay stagnation, program-status signals from the Federal Register, and FY25 renewal patterns?

matches.note: Existing FY25-26 window; needs FY24 pull as a new source. Existing DS is useful as F4.1 (renewal) reference.
Existing 18mo Federal Register pull; extends to Jan 2025. Needed to backfill FY23 to cover the 24mo signal window.

internal_scan.verdict: Two internal DSes are strong candidates for F4 (renewal via FY25 DS) and F3 (termination signal via Fed Register). Need a NEW pull for FY24-specific SLED grants (existing DS starts 2024-10-01 = FY25). Fed Register 18mo covers most of the 24mo signal window.

indicators.name: (Award Amount - Total Outlays) / Award Amount for awards ≥180d past Start
data_required: Award Amount, Total Outlays, Start Date
indicators.acceptance: Total Outlays populated on ≥80% of rows

indicators.name: Count of Fed Register termination / rescission / amendment actions per Awarding Sub Agency
data_required: Fed Register agency, action type / abstract keyword scan

candidates.result: OPTIONAL — 6mo backfill would upgrade F3 from AMBER to GREEN

indicators.acceptance: ≥200 candidate actions matched to an Awarding Sub Agency by name

indicators.name: Days since latest such action per sub-agency
Boolean: same recipient has ≥1 FY25 award from same sub-agency
data_required: FY25 grants with prime_award_recipient_id + Awarding Sub Agency

candidates.result: GREEN — this is the primary use of the internal DS

indicators.acceptance: existing DS has ≥1000 FY25 rows (verified in Phase 0 metrics)

indicators.name: Sub-agency clawback-signal density (F3.1 / award count)
data_required: F3.1 + FY24 award counts per sub-agency

preference_order_rule: INTERNAL first (partial Fed Register + FY25 SLED) → EXTERNAL FY24 pull → DERIVED. This is a hybrid: the answering flow bundles a new FY24 pull with references to two existing internal DSes.
approval_required_before_acquisition: None — USASpending and federalregister.gov both already approved.
gap_summary: F3 signal window: existing Fed Register DS covers 18mo (2025-01 onward). For a full 24mo signal window we'd re-pull with 2024-07-24 start. Downgraded to AMBER for the demo; the flow uses whatever the existing DS provides. Effect: FY24-Q1 terminations not counted; risk score may under-flag sub-agencies whose terminations were concentrated early.
